reviewNote: The imported Neutrona Buenos Aires 2 record uses Av. Isabel La Catolica 1324, but the available facility listings associate that address with a Telxius Barracas POP. Telxius' official colocation materials describe its services and Argentina coverage but do not identify a Neutrona facility at this address. The operators are not merged and no facts are promoted.

identity.notes: The imported Neutrona identity could not be matched to an official operator facility page; the address appears associated with a different operator in non-authoritative listings.
